subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub adopt a first-class publisher follow graph as a supported discovery, public API, and notification foundation?
rationale: The proposed durable social state and multi-PR notification roadmap establish product, privacy, and API commitments that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor the follow graph
options.body: Accept the direction, land the foundational API PR first, and review this rebased slice after documentation and runtime proof are added.

options.title: Keep the first version internal
options.body: Prototype discovery through internal authenticated Convex APIs without committing to the public HTTP contract yet.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Defer the three stacked PRs until a maintainer-sponsored specification establishes product scope and privacy expectations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the follow graph
recommendation.body: Accept the direction, land the foundational API PR first, and review this rebased slice after documentation and runtime proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision establishes a durable ClawHub product and API direction spanning discovery, persistence, and notifications.
